availability: Production server is not configured. Offline racing is available.
release_notes: Mobile map: restored missing and collapsed concrete wall faces in both streamed LODs. Three wall atlas materials now retain all 123,524 original triangles, UVs, normals and tangents per LOD.

PC graphics: fences, walls, signs and buildings keep their authored textures, PBR and transparency. The procedural ground shader no longer replaces every map material or converts translucent scenery into hard cutouts.
Texture verification: all 98 PC atlases match the source; all 971 mobile material/atlas bindings, 104 streamed textures and both protected wall LODs pass validation.
Rendering checks: 96 day/night Low/Medium/High map captures, packaged Windows map and driving checks, and resource loading of all 200 actual exported Android map scenes.
Preserved: original PC assets, restored source fences, shared collision/vehicle physics, steering controls, saved settings and protocol 4.

Preview limitation: physical Android rendering, FPS, touch, resume and phone/Windows cross-play remain unverified. Windows rendering of mobile assets does not qualify an Android GPU. Public multiplayer hosting remains unconfigured.
limitations: Physical Android installation testing remains incomplete.
